description: This file defines the `Crunched` formatter class for the SCSSPHP library, responsible for formatting SCSS output in a compressed, minimal style. It includes deprecated notices and methods for outputting CSS blocks and selectors.

classes.name: Crunched
classes.description: A formatter class that outputs compressed SCSS content, now deprecated in favor of the 'Compressed' formatter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the formatter with specific formatting settings and triggers a deprecation warning.

methods.name: blockLines
methods.description: Outputs the lines of a given output block, filtering out comments and formatting the lines in a compressed manner.

methods.name: blockSelectors
methods.description: Outputs the CSS selectors for a block, converting spaces around combinators to minimal form and appending the block's open brace.
